name: Crowley Wilmington Port Terminal - Wilmington NC

fieldNotes.location: Roster coords (34.196262,-77.948378) landed at the port's administrative/office area on Burnett Boulevard. 2202 Burnett Blvd is the address of the Port of Wilmington (NC State Ports Authority) container terminal, where Crowley operates its Wilmington marine service. The operational container terminal is SW of the office cluster — locked center ~34.1930,-77.9520.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Confirmed — Street View shows the divided port access road leading to a controlled gate; z20 satellite shows a gate booth structure with lane markings and a barrier arm, with a tractor-trailer passing through.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A gate booth structure sits at the gate lanes (visible in z19-20 satellite). Marine terminal under MTSA/port security. remoteGs = false.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Divided multi-lane port access road with separate inbound/outbound lanes through the gate complex.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Marine container terminal — cargo handling is vessel-side via gantry cranes, not building dock doors. Few warehouse dock positions visible; band 0-10, low confidence.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very large container/chassis marshalling yard with extensive container stacks and chassis rows.
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail line runs into and along the terminal (rail crossing on the access road visible in Street View); on-dock rail. railServed = true.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Port campus: container yard, multiple warehouse/admin buildings, berths, gantry cranes.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide divided gate apron with multiple lanes and spare paved width.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Approximately 2 in / 2 out — estimate from satellite, flagged uncertain.

citations.claim: The Port of Wilmington NC container terminal is owned and operated by the North Carolina State Ports Authority.
Crowley Maritime is listed by NC Ports as a service provider/carrier at the port, not the terminal operator.
Crowley offers weekly fixed-day LO/LO liner service from the Port of Wilmington to Central America - a carrier calling the port, not a terminal operator.

verification.rationale: Different operator: NC State Ports Authority operates the Wilmington container terminal; Crowley is a liner carrier calling the port, not a yard operator at the address.
